sourcedFrom: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 (undated beyond "REVISED 12.19" on the back page; an engineering sheet inside is dated 04/21/23)
cleanIntro:
The PWS UXR is a semi-automatic rifle on a long-stroke gas piston, built so the owner can change caliber: the barrel, bolt head and magwell are swapped as a matched set between .308 Win, .223 Wylde and .300 BLK, each part marked with an identification symbol. A three-position rocker valve at the gas block sets Normal, Adverse or Suppressed gas.

The field strip is short: one takedown pin out to its stop, the trigger housing group off the back, the recoil spring mount pressed forward and down, and the recoil spring assembly and bolt carrier group slide out of the rear of the upper receiver. PWS recommends cleaning and lubricating after 500 rounds suppressed or 1,200 rounds unsuppressed.

steps.title: On SAFE — magazine out
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction and keep it there. Put the ambi safety selector on SAFE, press the magazine release and remove the magazine.
steps.prose: With a magazine seated, opening the action only feeds the next round into the chamber.
steps.quote: VERIFY THE SAFETY SELECTOR IS ON SAFE AND THE FIREARM MAGAZINE IS REMOVED.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 1, printed p.11

steps.title: LOOK into the chamber
steps.action: Draw the charging handle back to open the action and look into the chamber. See it empty of ammunition before going further.
steps.prose: The look is the check — not hearing nothing fall out.
steps.quote: LOOK INTO THE CHAMBER AND VERIFY ITS CLEAR OF AMMUNITION.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 1, printed p.11

steps.title: Takedown pin out — trigger housing group off the back
steps.action: Pull the takedown pin out until it reaches its hard stop. Then pull the trigger housing group rearward off the receiver.
steps.prose: The pin is captive: it stops at its hard stop, it does not come out of the gun.
steps.quote: PULL THE TAKEDOWN PIN OUT TO THE HARD STOP AND PULL THE TRIGGER HOUSING GROUP REARWARD TO REMOVE.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 2, printed p.11

steps.title: Recoil spring mount: forward, then down
steps.action: Keep a hand over the recoil spring mount. Press it forward, then downward, to disengage it from the receiver.
steps.prose: The recoil spring is compressed behind the mount; let it out under control.
steps.caution: THE SPRING IS UNDER PRESSURE AND IF UNCONTROLLED MAY LAUNCH TOWARDS USER UNDER FORCE
steps.quote: PRESS RECOIL SPRING MOUNT FORWARD AND THEN DOWNWARD TO DISENGAGE THE MOUNT.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 3, printed p.12

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Take the recoil spring assembly out of the rear of the receiver.
steps.prose: It comes out as an assembly; nothing on it needs to come apart.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 3, printed p.12

steps.title: Charging handle fully forward
steps.action: Push the charging handle all the way forward before you try to draw the bolt carrier group out.
steps.prose: The charging handle carries an integral forward assist; until the handle is fully forward the forward assist still holds the carrier.
steps.quote: CHARGING HANDLE MUST BE BIAS FULLY FORWARD FOR THE FORWARD ASSIST TO BE RELEASED AND BOLT CARRIER GROUP TO MOVE OUT INDEPENDENTLY
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 3, printed p.12

steps.title: Bolt carrier group out the rear
steps.action: Slide the bolt carrier group out of the rear of the upper receiver.
steps.prose: If it drags, the charging handle is not fully forward.
steps.quote: THE RECOIL SPRING ASSEMBLY AND BOLT CARRIER GROUP WILL SLIDE OUT FROM THE REAR OF THE UPPER RECEIVER.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — XCHANGE Conversion Process, step 3, printed p.12

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the upper receiver with barrel and handguard, the trigger housing group, the recoil spring assembly and the bolt carrier group. DEEP CLEAN carries PWS's bolt disassembly, the trigger pack out of its housing and the gas valve out of the gas block.
steps.prose: This is the disassembly PWS's lubrication page sends you to before cleaning.
steps.quote: To lubricate your firearm, follow disassembly instructions on the previous pages. Then use a solvent to flush debris from surfaces of BCG assembly.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Lubrication, printed p.25

deepSteps.title: Firing pin retaining pin out to its stop
deepSteps.action: Keep a finger on the back of the firing pin. Pull the firing pin retaining pin out until it reaches its hard stop; that releases the firing pin.
deepSteps.prose: The firing pin is under its spring's tension and pushes back against your finger as the retaining pin clears.
deepSteps.caution: MAINTAIN A FINGER ON THE BACK OF THE FIRING PIN AS IT IS UNDER SPRING TENSION.
deepSteps.quote: PULL THE FIRING PIN RETAINING PIN OUT TO HARD STOP TO RELEASE THE FIRING PIN.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Bolt Assembly, step 4A, printed p.13

deepSteps.title: Firing pin out the rear
deepSteps.action: Draw the firing pin out of the rear of the bolt carrier. The firing pin spring can come out with it, but it does not have to.
deepSteps.prose: With the pin out, the firing pin recess in the bolt can be cleaned of carbon.
deepSteps.quote: REMOVE FIRING PIN FROM THE REAR OF THE BOLT CARRIER.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Bolt Assembly, step 4B, printed p.13

deepSteps.title: Cam pin out — tap the carrier
deepSteps.action: With the firing pin out, tap the side of the carrier until the cam pin works out of its slot.
deepSteps.prose: PWS's order: the firing pin comes out first, then the cam pin.
deepSteps.quote: THE CAM PIN CAN BE REMOVED, ONCE THE FIRING PIN IS EXTRACTED, BY TAPPING THE SIDE OF THE CARRIER TO PERSUADE THE CAM PIN TO EXIT THE SLOT.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Bolt Assembly, step 4C, printed p.14

deepSteps.title: Bolt head out the front
deepSteps.action: With the cam pin out, slide the bolt head assembly out of the front of the bolt carrier.
deepSteps.prose: The bolt head is the caliber part: its identification symbol must match the barrel and magwell when it goes back in.
deepSteps.caution: ALWAYS VERIFY BOLT HEAD CALIBER DESIGNATION WHEN PERFORMING A CALIBER CHANGE.
deepSteps.quote: ONCE THE CAM PIN IS REMOVED, THE BOLT HEAD ASSEMBLY CAN BE REMOVED FORWARD OF THE BOLT CARRIER ASSEMBLY FOR EXCHANGE.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Bolt Assembly, step 4D, printed p.14

deepSteps.title: Selector detent button down
deepSteps.action: On the trigger housing group, press the safety selector detent button down and keep it pressed while you work the ambi safety.
deepSteps.prose: Keep the button down through the next two steps as well.
deepSteps.quote: PRESS SAFETY SELECTOR DETENT BUTTON DOWN AND MAINTAIN PRESSURE WHILE MANIPULATING THE AMBI-SAFETY.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, Trigger Housing Removal, step 1, printed p.18

deepSteps.title: Small ambi selector out
deepSteps.action: Still pressing the detent button, rotate the small ambi selector past the SAFE icon. At the right spot it pulls straight out.
deepSteps.prose: If it will not pull out, it is not rotated far enough.
deepSteps.quote: WHILE PRESSING THE DETENT BUTTON, OVER ROTATE THE SMALL, AMBI SAFETY SELECTOR UNDER THE “SAFE” ICON AS SHOWN. WHEN ROTATED INTO THE CORRECT SPOT, THE SMALL, AMBI SELECTOR WILL PULL STRAIGHT OUT.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, Trigger Housing Removal, step 2, printed p.19

deepSteps.title: Safety selector out
deepSteps.action: Still pressing the detent button, rock the safety selector slightly back and forth while pulling it outward.
deepSteps.prose: Small rocking movements, steady outward pull.
deepSteps.quote: WHILE PRESSING THE DETENT BUTTON, SLIGHTLY ROTATE SAFETY SELECTOR BACK AND FORTH WHILE PULLING OUTWARDS.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, Trigger Housing Removal, step 3, printed p.20

deepSteps.title: Trigger pack out of the housing
deepSteps.action: Pull the trigger pack straight out of the trigger housing.
deepSteps.prose: The pack comes out as one unit for maintenance or replacement.
deepSteps.quote: TRIGGER PACK MAY BE PULLED STRAIGHT OUT OF THE HOUSING FOR TRIGGER MAINTENANCE OR REPLACEMENT.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, Trigger Housing Removal, step 4, printed p.20

deepSteps.title: Gas valve to Adverse or Suppressed
deepSteps.action: Turn the rocker valve to the Adverse or the Suppressed setting.
deepSteps.prose: PWS starts the valve removal from one of these two settings.
deepSteps.quote: POSITION THE VALVE IN THE ADVERSE OR SUPPRESSED SETTING.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, gas valve, step 1, printed p.21

deepSteps.title: Valve stop pressed — rotate 180 and lift the arm
deepSteps.action: Press the valve stop with the tip of a bullet or a tool and rotate it 180 degrees. Then lift the valve adjustment arm assembly upward.
deepSteps.prose: The narrow end of the rifle service tool is the tool PWS names for the gas adjustment knob.
deepSteps.quote: PRESS THE VALVE STOP WITH A TIP OF BULLET OR A TOOL AND ROTATE 180 DEGREES. THEN LIFT THE VALVE ADJUSTMENT ARM ASSEMBLY UPWARDS.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, gas valve, step 2, printed p.21

deepSteps.title: Gas valve out the back of the gas block
deepSteps.action: Pull the valve out of the back of the gas block. Clean the carbon off it and reinstall it once clean.
deepSteps.prose: PWS's instruction: clean and remove carbon, reinstall once clean.
deepSteps.quote: PULL THE VALVE OUT THE BACK OF THE GAS BLOCK.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Disassembly for Maintenance, gas valve, step 3, printed p.22

deepSteps.title: Handguard stays on — PWS's stopping point
deepSteps.action: Stop here. The handguard stays on the rifle; carbon on the barrel under it is cleaned in place.
deepSteps.prose: The barrel, trunnion screws and magwell come off only in the book's caliber-conversion process, not in its maintenance disassembly.
deepSteps.quote: We do not suggest removing the handguard on your firearm as it is not necessary and can cause accuracy issues if not re-installed properly.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems UXR — Owner's Manual — REVISED 12.19 — printed on the back page; file name UXR-Manual-1-1 — Gas System / In-Depth Maintenance, printed p.28

cleaning.name: BOLT CARRIER GROUP
tasks: Flush the surfaces of the bolt carrier group with solvent.
A Scotch-Brite pad may be used on hardened carbon on the bolt carrier group parts and the piston head.
Deep clean: with the firing pin out, clean the carbon out of the firing pin recess in the bolt.
Reassemble the bolt carrier group and lubricate all of it, every contact point well.
⚠ Piston rod and piston head: wipe them down only — PWS says they do not need lubrication.

cleaning.name: PISTON TUBE AND BUFFER TUBE
tasks: A .40 cal cleaning brush through the piston tube to clear carbon and debris.
Flush the buffer tube with solvent and remove the excess.
An even layer of lubricant inside the buffer tube.

cleaning.name: BARREL UNDER THE HANDGUARD
tasks: Carbon on the barrel under the handguard: oil and a brush or a cotton swab to rub it off.
⚠ Leave the handguard on — PWS warns that removing it can cause accuracy issues if it is not re-installed properly.

cleaning.name: GAS VALVE
tasks: Deep clean: clean and remove the carbon from the gas valve, then reinstall it.

reassembly: Deep clean only: gas valve back into the back of the gas block, the reverse of its removal; then set the rocker valve to Normal, Adverse or Suppressed for how you will shoot.
Deep clean only: trigger pack straight back into the housing, flush and parallel in it; safety selector and the small ambi selector back in with the detent button held down.
Deep clean only: bolt head into the front of the carrier, cam pin into its slot, firing pin (and its spring) in from the rear, firing pin retaining pin pushed back in.
Bolt carrier group and recoil spring assembly back into the rear of the upper receiver; recoil spring mount re-engaged, under control.
Trigger housing group back onto the receiver on its tongue-and-groove connection and the takedown pin pushed back in.
⚠ Before loading: the magwell, bolt head and barrel identification symbols must match — PWS's conversion chart is on printed p.9 of its book.
Run the function check before loading.
fncheck: PWS's book publishes no function check. Clear the rifle first. Confirm the magwell, bolt head and barrel identification symbols all match each other and the ammunition you will load. Confirm the takedown pin is fully home and the rocker valve sits in one of its three settings. Then clear the rifle again.
